name: Can I repair a leaking skylight myself?
description: Professional repair is recommended for leaking skylights due to specialized knowledge and tools required to prevent further damage.

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a leaking skylight myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor leaks or condensation issues might seem like simple DIY fixes, repairing a leaking skylight often requires specialized knowledge, tools, and materials to ensure a lasting seal and prevent further damage. Improper repair can lead to more significant water intrusion, rot, or even structural problems. For safety and effectiveness, it's generally recommended to hire a professional. A professional will also be able to correctly diagnose whether the leak is from the skylight itself or an issue with the surrounding roof.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional repair is recommended for leaking skylights due to specialized knowledge and tools required to prevent further damage.
